title: London AI Summit 2026 - travel & expense reminders (scratchpad)
content:
London AI Summit 2026 - quick admin + expense scratchpad

High-level: attending with product + solutions team. I am coordinating logistics and expense reminders for the group. This is messy notes to share with Alex/Ollie before we finalize reimbursements.

Key dates
- Summit dates: 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12 (main expo + talks).
- Travel window: arrive 03-09 evening, depart 03-13 morning (flex depending on flights).

People (who I'm tracking)
- Maya Singh (me) - conference lead for Redwood booth and talk prep
- Alex Martinez - solutions; needs late return flight (03-13)
- Olivia Park - product; arriving 03-09 midday
- Jordan Kim - demo engineer; bringing demo laptop + power kit

Vendors / contacts (quick)
- Hotel: Park Lane Conference Hotel (group rate)
  - Contact: Sarah Bennett (events) - sarah.bennett@parklane.co.uk / +44 20 7444 1000
  - Group booking ref: REDWOOD-0226 (confirm by 2026-02-25)
- AV vendor: LondonAV Pros
  - Contact: Mark Ellis - mark@londonavpros.co.uk / +44 7700 900111
  - Quote attached in Confluence page (ask for 15% off for non-profit partner?)
- Shuttle / ground: CityShuttle UK (airport -> hotel return)
  - Contact: bookings@cityshuttle.co.uk / 020-8000-2222
- Catering (booth snacks): Borough Booth Catering (small platters + coffee)
  - Contact: info@boroughcatering.co.uk

Expense reminders (for team) - to share before travel
- Mandatory: collect itemized receipts for all meals, taxis, parking, and hotel incidentals. Credit card statements alone are not sufficient for meal per-diem exceptions.
- Per diem: UK per-diem policy for conference travel is £60/day (covers meals + incidental). If you claim above per-diem, need itemized receipts and justification.
- Meals with customers: record attendee names and purpose in expense note (e.g., "customer dinner - Acme Corp - demo follow-up").
- Taxis/Ubers: save the receipt screenshot with driver name/time OR export from Uber app.
- Foreign currency: submit original receipt and select GBP in expense tool; DO NOT convert manually. We reimburse in USD on payroll date at the company rate.
- Corporate card: Ava (Ops) has the corporate card for hotel incidentals. If used, put a note in expense system so we don't double reimburse.

Reimbursement workflow (short)
- Upload receipts to expense.redwood.ai within 14 days of return. Tag expenses with project: "LondonAI-2026" or "TRVL-487".
- Approvers: direct manager + travel-admin (me) for exceptions above £200.
- GL codes: default to "events:marketing:conferences" unless demo hardware purchased, then use "capital:hardware".

Booth & demo logistics (admin notes)
- Shipping: booth materials ship to Park Lane Hotel receiving - use the hotel's receiving form (Confluence has template). Drop-off date 03-09 before noon.
- Demo laptop: Jordan bringing MacBook Pro 16" (serial note in asset tracker). Ensure GPU-enabled demo runs locally - confirm model size under 6GB VRAM or we use cloud demo.
- Power: bring UK travel adapters (3-pin), power strip, and labelled cables. Mark labelling: "REDWOOD - demo - Jordan"

To-dos (actionable)
- [ ] Confirm group hotel reservation with Sarah by 2026-02-25 (Maya)
- [ ] Confirm AV quote & final run-of-show with Mark (Jordan)
- [ ] Post reminder in #travel Slack channel 2026-02-28 with receipt checklist (Maya)
- [ ] Add expense pre-approval for demo hardware rental if >£500 (Alex)
- [ ] Finalize demo packaging and shipping label (Jordan)

Notes to self (loose)
- Check Concur vs new expense.redwood.ai UI differences - I keep getting confused about per-diem selection. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TRAVEL/Expense+tools
- Double-check visa requirements for team (non-EU passports) - Olivia might need a short-stay visa depending on nationality.

Fragmented / stuff to include in shared email to team (short checklist bullets)
- Flights + itineraries, hotel check-in instructions, meeting point at booth for booth shifts, who to call for emergency (ops pager: ops-pager@redwood.ai), how to submit last-minute receipts.

Quick references used in this doc
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TRAVEL/London+AI+Summit+2026
- Jira ticket: TRVL-487 (team approvals + pre-approval)
- Slack thread: #travel - message id: slack://channel?thread=F12345 (paste final reminder there)

End of scratchpad - will clean up and convert to email + checklist before 2026-02-28.
